lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ki tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word, you ask me, what are you?

lines: Tumhin kaho ke ye andaaz-e-guftagu kya hai?
couplets.en: You tell me, what manner of speaking is this?

lines: Jala hai jism jahaan dil bhi jal gaya hoga
couplets.en: Where the body burned, the heart must have burned too.

lines: Kuredte ho jo ab raakh, justaju kya hai?
couplets.en: What are you looking for now, sifting through the ashes?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ki tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word, you ask me, what are you?

lines: Na shole mein ye karishma, na barq mein ye ada
couplets.en: Flame has no such magic, and lightning no such grace.

lines: Koi batao ki woh shokh-e-tund-khu kya hai?
couplets.en: Can anyone tell me what to make of that fierce, teasing beloved?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ki tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word, you ask me, what are you?

lines: Ragon mein daurte phirne ke hum nahin qaail
couplets.en: Blood coursing through the veins hardly persuades me.

lines: Jab aankh hi se na tapka to phir lahu kya hai?
couplets.en: What good is blood if it never falls from the eye?

lines: Har ek baat pe kehte ho tum ki tu kya hai?
couplets.en: At every word, you ask me, what are you?

lines: Rahi na taaqat-e-guftaar, aur agar ho bhi
couplets.en: The strength to speak is gone, and even if some remained.

lines: To kis umeed pe kahiye ke aarzoo kya hai?
couplets.en: With what hope could I say what I long for?

lines: Bana hai shaah ka musaahib, phire hai itraata
couplets.en: Made a companion to the king, he goes about preening.

lines: Vagarna shehr mein Ghalib ki aabru kya hai?
couplets.en: What standing would Ghalib otherwise have in this city?
